name: Re:
source:
One day Morikawa's mother tells him that they're moving to live in America with his father in ten days. The protagonist doesn't want to move, but has a little choice in this matter. What can he do during the remaining time? Play with his friends? Have a farewell party?
"I wish I had a girlfriend. But only ten days... it's hopeless". At the moment he doesn't know that a certain deity is already setting his life on a new course...
translation:
一天，森川的母亲告诉他，十天后全家将搬去美国与父亲共同生活。主人公不想离开，却几乎没有选择余地。剩下的时间里，他能做些什么？与朋友玩耍？举办告别聚会？
“真希望自己有个女朋友。可只剩十天…根本没希望。”此时的他还不知道，某位神明已经开始把他的人生引向一条全新道路…
